componentBoundary.backend: Authoritative RideX booking/auth/OTP/business state; invokes Provider over authenticated service contract.
componentBoundary.provider: Owns delivery jobs, Gateway enrollment/control, command dispatch, delivery result and retry outbox; cannot override RideX booking/payment state.
componentBoundary.androidGateway: Device-bound delivery worker; authenticates to Provider, fetches signed config/commands, executes approved actions and reports results through a durable local outbox.

gatewayId.sourceOfTruth: Provider/Gateway registration plus Backend/Admin provisioning contract

deviceId.sourceOfTruth: Authenticated heartbeat and Gateway session binding

installationId.meaning: Installation binding value used with Gateway and device identity

assignedMobileNumber.meaning: Separately assigned provisioning/business phone number supplied by Super Admin/Admin enrollment flow

deviceName.meaning: The assigned user mobile number under the approved RideX identity convention
deviceName.sourceOfTruth: Derived on Provider side from assignedMobileNumber; must not replace deviceId or gatewayId

observedQueueFields: deliveryAttemptResults: per-attempt ACK outcome history, bounded by the existing maximum delivery-attempt policy (maximum configured delivery attempts remains an unresolved policy decision).
securityBoundaries: Enrollment rate-limit; credential/session rotation; device-to-gateway binding; signed configuration; signed remote commands; per-device auth; revocation/control state; encrypted SMS payload; backend result outbox; security audit.
Gateway command ACK outcome history is persisted per delivery attempt for idempotent replay; Backend delivery-result URL path must exactly match /api/v1/provider/delivery-results.
Required Provider configuration readiness now includes RIDEX_BACKEND_RESULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS in PRODUCTION and validates a positive integer without assigning an unapproved maximum.

Production readiness and signed-config generation now require explicit positive values for config version/TTL, heartbeat/offline thresholds, daily SMS limit and SMS/call max attempts; offline-after must exceed heartbeat interval. RX-DEC-043 upper-bound decision remains open; no new maximum was invented.

storageSelectionObserved.sourceBehavior: PROVIDER_STORAGE_DRIVER is required explicitly in TEST and PRODUCTION; missing/invalid values fail closed. JSON, SQLite and PostgreSQL implementations coexist. JSON is rejected in PRODUCTION; authoritative driver selection remains an owner decision.
storageSelectionObserved.corruptJsonBehavior: Fail closed with PROVIDER_DATA_CORRUPT for empty/corrupt persisted JSON; never silently replace existing state with empty state.

pendingFinalReview: Choose exactly one authoritative Provider persistence driver per environment and establish migration/rollback ownership; do not run multiple drivers as competing authorities.
Review gateway-auth.service.ts sync and async enrollment/session paths for duplicate behavior before consolidation.
Confirm SIM/SMS/call permissions and provider delivery outcomes only in the final approved device test.

Verify historical Gateway command ACK replay across all delivery attempts, stale-lease recovery, exact callback path matching and production retry-setting validation with concurrency/restart evidence; physical tests remain deferred.

commandDeliverySemanticsObserved.releaseEffect: NOT VERIFIED until device/provider runtime tests prove exact-attempt ACK replay, lease expiry, retry and restart recovery.
commandDeliverySemanticsObserved.implementationEvidence: Exact delivery-attempt ACK is persisted in bounded history; stale/mismatched attempts are rejected. Runtime concurrency/restart tests remain pending.
